**Date:** Wednesday 11 November 2026  
**Time:** 09:00 - 10:30  
**Venue:** QT Perth, Murray Room

**Chair:** Scott Chapman

## Summary

Hear from the University of Queensland node on AAGI tools and support, drone and satellite data for oats, wheat leaf area index (LAE) estimation, microphenotyping, and the use of large language models in agricultural grey literature.
